parser_failures.reason: expected at least two ABBR paragraph passages
expected one common delimiter (',', ':', or '=') across all definitions; observed candidate delimiters none with no valid common delimiter
expected a TABLE/table passage immediately after the title
first abbreviation paragraph did not match X (Y) or X, Y

instructions.question: Which complete outcome is most faithful to the abbreviation-section evidence?
rules: Select a candidate only when every emitted pair is supported by the source.
A legal layout alone does not prove an abbreviation relationship.
Do not turn table headers, ordinary prose, citations, approval identifiers, or publisher notes into pairs.
Prefer needs_parser_extension when genuine definitions exist but no candidate is complete and precise.

reject_section.choose_when: The source is not a real abbreviation/glossary section or contains no usable abbreviation definitions.
reject_section.not_when: Do not choose merely because publisher artifacts or later body text follow an otherwise valid list.

needs_parser_extension.choose_when: The source contains real abbreviation definitions, but none of the candidate parses captures all and only the usable relationships with the correct endpoint.
needs_parser_extension.not_when: Do not choose if one candidate is already faithful, even if its grammar label is imperfect.
